title: Aligned switches with Kelly counts up to 4 (Theorem BS4) are reconstructible
statement_en: Theorem BS4 (aligned switch with Kelly counts up to 4, t1.md sections 3-5 of the diameter-2 no_triple_window directory): every graph G on at least 3 vertices such that for every set D of vertex pairs (a graph on the same vertices) that is switchable (each pair w y of D has y1, w1 outside {w, y} such that the degree of y1 in G − w is deg y − 1 + [w~y], the degree of w1 in G − y is deg w − 1 + [w~y], and G − w − y1 ≅ G − y − w1), degree-balanced (at every vertex v and degree k, D-pairs at v towards degree-k vertices split evenly into edges and non-edges of G), and keeps the induced counts of every graph on k ≤ 4 (k < n) vertices, G △ D is isomorphic to G; is reconstructible.
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => ∀ D : SimpleGraph (Fin n), (∀ w y : Fin n, D.Adj w y → (∃ y₁ w₁ : Fin n, y₁ ≠ w ∧ y₁ ≠ y ∧ w₁ ≠ w ∧ w₁ ≠ y ∧ (G.Adj w y → (G.Adj w y₁ → (G.neighborSet y₁).ncard = (G.neighborSet y).ncard + 1) ∧ (¬ G.Adj w y₁ → (G.neighborSet y₁).ncard = (G.neighborSet y).ncard) ∧ (G.Adj y w₁ → (G.neighborSet w₁).ncard = (G.neighborSet w).ncard + 1) ∧ (¬ G.Adj y w₁ → (G.neighborSet w₁).ncard = (G.neighborSet w).ncard)) ∧ (¬ G.Adj w y → (G.Adj w y₁ → (G.neighborSet y₁).ncard = (G.neighborSet y).ncard) ∧ (¬ G.Adj w y₁ → (G.neighborSet y₁).ncard + 1 = (G.neighborSet y).ncard) ∧ (G.Adj y w₁ → (G.neighborSet w₁).ncard = (G.neighborSet w).ncard) ∧ (¬ G.Adj y w₁ → (G.neighborSet w₁).ncard + 1 = (G.neighborSet w).ncard)) ∧ Nonempty (G.induce ({w, y₁}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({y, w₁}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))))) → (∀ v : Fin n, ∀ k : ℕ, {y : Fin n | D.Adj v y ∧ G.Adj v y ∧ (G.neighborSet y).ncard = k}.ncard = {y : Fin n | D.Adj v y ∧ ¬ G.Adj v y ∧ (G.neighborSet y).ncard = k}.ncard) → (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 4 → k < n → ∀ F : SimpleGraph (Fin k), {S : Finset (Fin n) | Nonempty ((symmDiff G D).induce (S : Set (Fin n)) ≃g F)}.ncard = {S : Finset (Fin n) | Nonempty (G.induce (S : Set (Fin n)) ≃g F)}.ncard) → Nonempty (G ≃g symmDiff G D))
